title: STEM OPT Financial Runway Planner
description: Financial runway model for F-1 international students navigating OPT and STEM OPT. Models H-1B lottery probability across up to 3 annual attempts, savings trajectory at each milestone, worst-case balance if status lapses, EB-2 NIW path viability, cap-exempt employer strategy, and priority date wait by country of birth.
data_vintage: USCIS H-1B cap-subject selection rate FY2025 · OPT/STEM OPT regulations 2024 · EB-2 priority dates 2025
regulatory_citations: USCIS H-1B cap-subject selection rate FY2025 (~18.5% for regular cap)
8 CFR §214.2(f) OPT and STEM OPT regulations (24-month STEM extension)
EB-2 NIW eligibility: Matter of Dhanasar 2016 (USCIS AAO)
